name: Standing Settlement Instruction 20
definition: Details of the standing settlement instruction to be applied.

SettlementStandingInstructionDatabase.name: Settlement Standing Instruction Database
SettlementStandingInstructionDatabase.definition: Specifies what settlement standing instruction database is to be used to derive the settlement parties involved in the transaction.

Counterparty.name: Counterparty
Counterparty.definition: Identification of the buyer or seller in a standing settlement instruction enabling to derive the Standing Settlement Instruction.

Vendor.name: Vendor
Vendor.definition: Vendor of the settlement standing instruction database that is to be consulted.

OtherDeliveringSettlementParties.name: Other Delivering Settlement Parties
OtherDeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Delivering parties, other than the seller, needed for deriving the standing settlement instruction (for example, depository) or provided for information purposes (for example, instructing party settlement chain).

OtherReceivingSettlementParties.name: Other Receiving Settlement Parties
OtherReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Receiving parties, other than the buyer, needed for deriving the standing settlement instruction (for example, depository) or provided for information purposes (for example, instructing party settlement chain).

VendorPresenceRule.definition: If the settlement standing instruction database is a vendor database, then the vendor must be identified.
